dialogues.speaker: Churin
dialogues.text: But... But Master Bragin, I'm not sure if I can keep doing this.

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Oh, come now! If you can't even resist this cold, how will you be able to feel the blizzard's might like those blasted Snegovik do?

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Hang in there a while longer, Churin, Fadeev!

dialogues.speaker: Churin
dialogues.text: *whimper*...

dialogues.speaker: Fadeev
dialogues.text: Y—You're right, Master!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, what are you doing out here in this crazy cold?

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Huh. I didn't think a deserted ice-carving workshop like ours would get guests. Are you two also adherents of the Path of the Ice Sculpt-Dancer?

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Hmm. You there, blondie! You walk through these frigid winds without any irregularity in your footwork... You must be an incredible fighter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this Path of the Ice Sculpt-Dancer, anyway? Is it a dance mat you make from Prime Ice?

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Hahah. Looks like you don't quite get it, Miss. Creating ice sculptures using Prime Ice techniques is an art unique in all the world to Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: And carving should be elegant, like a dance.

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Once upon a time, I was able to enter the Pale Crown Palace and perform before the very throne of the Belyi Tsar, by dint of my ability to slice Prime Ice with my bare hands.

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: To my shame, the noble lady of the Snegurochka said that my sculptures lacked the breath of the blizzard in nature... Her words — Lady Pavlina's words — roused inspiration within me...

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: After that day, I built a training ground here, and have made it my life's work to sculpt amidst the blizzard, pursuing ever greater artistic heights!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohhh...

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Are the two of you not here for that same reason?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're just adventurers...

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Incredible... Incredible. To think there'd be adventurers who could reach this place...

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. I've heard my disciples say that adventurers from the Adventurers' Guild will sometimes take on these... commissions. Is that right, Churin?

dialogues.speaker: Churin
dialogues.text: Yes, Master Churin! But... we'll have to pay them...

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Oh, come now, I can afford remuneration of a sort. In any case, good adventurer, could I commission you to spar with us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Spar? How? Do you mean... in Prime Ice sculpting?

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Oh, nay, not that. I refer to a physical duel. After all, the Path of the Ice Sculpt-Dancer is also a martial art...

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: So, how about it? Would you grace us with your presence?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you meant a fight... Well, sure. We aren't scared of anyone!

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: What do you say, great adventurer? Would you like to spar with us Domovoy — we who pursue the path of the ice sculptor?

response.speaker: Bragin
response.text: My thanks for your aid. I am sure this will help my apprentices see how vast this world is.

choices.text: It doesn't quite strike my fancy at the moment...

response.speaker: Bragin
response.text: Is that so? When you're willing, mighty adventurer, simply say the word.

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Wonderful! I never thought I'd meet one as strong as you, adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Sparring with you has filled me with inspiration like a flowing spring... Ah, marvelous.

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Here, this is your payment... What a fine warm-up this match has been! My body is all toasty now, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Still, I must say that Churin is, in truth, the best fighter amongst us. His sculpting, though, could use some work...

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Find him if you'd like to spar with him! It'll do him good, trust me.

dialogues.speaker: Fadeev
dialogues.text: *sigh* Master, does your method really work, though?

dialogues.speaker: Fadeev
dialogues.text: I don't think I've made any progress in Prime Ice sculpting... Sure, I've gotten a lot faster, but that's it.

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: Well, is that not an improvement?

dialogues.speaker: Fadeev
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: I was summoned to perform at the Pale Crown Palace back then on account of my speed, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Bragin
dialogues.text: I could create a statue in but an instant. What, did you think I'd make His Majesty the Tsar sit there all day waiting for me to finish performing?

dialogues.speaker: Fadeev
dialogues.text: I—I see...

dialogues.speaker: Churin
dialogues.text: Hmm? What is it...? Do you need anything, adventurer?

choices.text: I'd like to go for another round...

response.speaker: Churin
response.text: A—Alright. Master did say that sparring would do me good as well...

response.speaker: Churin
response.text: Um... Then, please don't disturb me. I still need to finish my sculptures for today.
